notes: No study or test locator was supplied. Original effect size is printed partial eta squared, retained without conversion to requested Cohen’s f². Replication uses final Stage 2, not Stage 1 or pooled meta-analysis. Reported success uses the author’s narrative that the final comparison showed no difference and the descriptive direction opposed the stated criterion.
